verdict.rationale: Whether a vector database's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Pinecone publishing its source under any license. The first-party docs cover only managed-service features, and one community comment calls Pinecone 'the one database that is anti-FOSS', which points away from an open codebase rather than toward one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
